title: RuneScape Reignited cancelled after 2 weeks ❌
subject: runescape
description:
Was cancelling Reignited the right call? 👇

Jagex cancelled RuneScape Reignited on October 15, 2026, less than two weeks after revealing it at RuneFest on October 3. The fresh-start mode was due December 2. The free 10-day RuneScape trial starting December 2 and the 2027 roadmap are still going ahead.

Sources: Jagex blog post by Mod Ryan (Oct 15, 2026), PC Gamer (Oct 15, 2026), This Week in Videogames (Oct 16, 2026), Massively OP (Oct 7, 2026)
Game footage © Jagex.

scenes.text: Two weeks after revealing it, Jagex has scrapped RuneScape Reignited.
Jagex announced it at RuneFest on October 3, set for December 2.
It gave new and returning players fresh characters on separate servers. Veterans said that would split the community.
Four days after the reveal, Jagex apologized to existing players for making them feel sidelined.
On October 15, Mod Ryan wrote that Jagex missed the mark, and the mode was cancelled.
The free 10-day trial still starts December 2, and the 2027 roadmap stays.
